teaser.en: Digo simply borrowed the name of this newcomer fruit: the avocado is *ovakado*.
teaser.sw: Kidigo kiliazima tu jina la tunda hili lililofika karibuni: parachichi ni *ovakado*.
teaser.dg: Tunda hiri ni mjeni pwani, na Chidigo chahala tu dzinare: *avocado* ni *ovakado*.

summary.en: *Ovakado* is the avocado, an evergreen tree with oily, buttery fruit grown at some homesteads on the coast. Its Digo name is a borrowing.
summary.sw: *Ovakado* ni mparachichi, mti usiopukutisha majani wenye matunda yenye mafuta na laini kama siagi, unaopandwa katika baadhi ya makazi pwani. Jina lake la Kidigo ni la kuazima.
summary.dg: *Ovakado* (kpwa Chingereza *avocado*) ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, wenye matunda genye mafuha na laini dza siagi, unaomera midzi yanjina ya pwani. Dzinare ra Chidigo ni ra kuhala kula luga yanjina.

about.en: The avocado is an evergreen tree with large, leathery, oval leaves and clusters of small greenish-yellow flowers. The fruit is pear-shaped or round, with green or purplish-black skin around soft, oily, pale green flesh and a single large seed.
about.sw: Mparachichi ni mti usiopukutisha majani, wenye majani makubwa, magumu kama ngozi, yenye umbo la yai, na vishada vya maua madogo ya kijani-manjano. Tunda lina umbo la peari au la mviringo, likiwa na ganda la kijani au la zambarau-nyeusi linalozunguka nyama laini, yenye mafuta, ya kijani hafifu, na mbegu moja kubwa.
about.dg: *Ovakado* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, wenye makodza makulu, mafu dza chingo, ganayohalana na tumbi kpwa sura, na maruwa madide ga rangi ya chijani na mandano ganayokala makundi-makundi. Tunda rina umbo dza ra pea (*pear*) au ra mviringo; gadare ni ra chijani au ra zambarau-nyiru, na ndani kuna nyama laini zenye mafuha, za chijani ngushu-ngushu, na tembe mwenga dzikulu.

where.en: Avocado trees grow at some homesteads on the south coast.
where.sw: Miparachichi huota katika baadhi ya makazi katika pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Mihi ya ovakado inamera midzi yanjina ya pwani ya kusini.

names.en: The Digo name *ovakado* is borrowed from 'avocado'. Swahili calls the tree *mparachichi*. In English it is avocado.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo *ovakado* limeazimwa kutoka 'avocado'. Kwa Kiswahili mti huitwa *mparachichi*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *avocado*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo *ovakado* ni ra kuhala kula neno ra Chingereza 'avocado'. Chiswahili chinauiha muhi *mparachichi*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *avocado*.

reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa matunda wa nyumbani
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa matunda wa midzini.

reason.en: Another fruit introduced to the coast
reason.sw: Tunda lingine lililoletwa pwani kutoka nje
reason.dg: Tunda ranjina rirorehwa pwani kula tsi za kure.
